description: Bottom part of a clothing distribution list; several people receive a felt garment (libd). Names include "the acquaintance of Rabbenu(?)"; the wife of [...]; Umm Maḥfūẓa; and Senyor(?). The last seems unusual for the document's date (likely 11th or 12th century).
description_he: רשימה או טבלה ביהודית-ערבית. מוחזק בספריית קיימברידג'.
